description.zh:
指定暂停或开启云蜜罐实例。取值：

- **disable**：暂停
- **enable**：开启
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable the honeypot. Valid values:

*   **disable**
*   **enable**

description.zh:
要生效的云蜜罐实例的VPC ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeVpcHoneyPotList](~~DescribeVpcHoneyPotList~~)接口获取VPC ID。
description.en:
The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) on which the honeypot is deployed.

>  You can call the [DescribeVpcHoneyPotList](~~DescribeVpcHoneyPotList~~) operation to query the IDs of VPCs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas modify-vpc-honey-pot --vpc-id vpc-d7o009q63fqy21r8u0000 --honey-pot-action disable --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
